column1: # RoboCasa OpenCabinet benchmark — one policy per row. Tab-separated.
#   eval_script : path relative to mujoco-experience repo root (the eval orchestrator;
#                 each spawns its own policy server + the shared robocasa sim client).
#   ckpt        : checkpoint path the orchestrator loads (- to skip the row).
#   extra_args  : any extra flags for that orchestrator (or - for none).
